Programs, Minors and Certificates

The University of Southern California offers undergraduate and graduate programs across its schools and academic units. The programs marked with an asterisk fall under the jurisdiction of the Dornsife College of Letters, Arts and Sciences. Programs are listed with the credential awarded. Use the links below to open each program's official catalogue page, including admission requirements, degree requirements, course lists and footnotes for the 2026-2027 academic year.

Featured this month: Astronautical Engineering (BS) appears in the featured carousel and must not be treated as part of any section listing.
